candidate: H65 layer-private Householder transport of one learned global MLP frame

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H64 improves mean covariance to 73.036% mainly by widening one learned shared frame, while non-commuting code-local middle maps add only 0.237 point and layer-0 remains at 58.74%. Move the global frame into layer-private ambient input/output subspaces with compact orthogonal transports rather than enriching the middle operator again.

scientific_question: Can short layer-private Householder products transport one learned global frame into the depth-specific ambient subspaces required for heldout dense-MLP function and exact-JVP recovery under one percent state?

frozen_teacher.procedural_parent_policy: Use exact step-zero MLP tensors in the audit; exclude them from the compact artifact and require independent config-seed regeneration identity before any later model training.

frozen_function_inventory.activation_anchor: exact per-layer mean of the frozen training input inventory, charged and stored as FP16

frozen_representation.formula: y0_l=f0_l(x); hard codes route through factored scores; xin=P_in_l(x-mu_l); t=P_out_l U(q_l*(V^T xin)); yhat_l=y0_l+sum_m g_lmk C_mk+o_l+t
frozen_representation.routing_forward: hard argmax independently in each of three banks
frozen_representation.routing_backward_during_fit: straight-through softmax with frozen temperature 1.0 for parameter gradients
frozen_representation.routing_jvp_for_fit_and_gate: exact hard piecewise-affine local derivative, excluding routing-boundary derivative
frozen_representation.householder_definition: H(v)=I-2vv^T/(v^Tv), applied directly without storing a dense matrix

initialization.householder_distribution: independent standard normal vectors, normalized only by the exact reflector formula
initialization.initial_function: exact step-zero procedural MLP because ambient codebook, tangent U, and output offsets are zero

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact hard piecewise-affine input-JVP MSE
fit.optimizer: AdamW on compact coordinates except frozen charged activation anchors
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.step_zero_parent: zero codebook, tangent U, and output offsets
controls.identity_transports: replace every input/output reflector product by identity while retaining the fitted frame, diagonal, hard values, and offsets
controls.input_transport_only: retain fitted input reflectors and replace output reflectors by identity
controls.output_transport_only: retain fitted output reflectors and replace input reflectors by identity
controls.one_reflector_per_side: retain only reflector zero on the input and output sides
controls.shared_across_layers: replace each layer reflector bank by the exact across-layer mean bank
controls.piecewise_tangent_only: zero codebook and offsets while retaining transported tangent
controls.hard_value_only: zero tangent U and output offsets; exact JVP must equal the parent JVP
controls.initial_random_router: replace fitted router factors by their exact deterministic initialization
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for any run observed or projected above five minutes
